recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞極度增生，滿是細胞質粉紅、帶顆粒的嗜酸性球；CD117 與 CD25 標出散在或鬆散聚集的紡錘形肥大細胞，網狀纖維染色顯示明顯纖維化，符合伴嗜酸性球增多與 FIP1L1::PDGFRA 重排的骨髓/淋巴腫瘤。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (A) replaced by sheets of eosinophils and eosinophil precursors with bright eosinophilic granular cytoplasm
CD117 (B) highlights numerous spindle-shaped mast cells, singly and in loose interstitial clusters with occasional small dense aggregates
CD25 (C) is expressed by the same spindle mast cells, indicating an aberrant immunophenotype
Reticulin stain (D) shows diffuse dense coarse fiber network with intersections, consistent with marked fibrosis (MF-3)
No sheets of blasts identifiable at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is markedly hypercellular, with the intertrabecular space filled by eosinophils and their precursors. CD117 and CD25 immunostains highlight increased spindle-shaped mast cells distributed singly and in loose interstitial clusters, with rare dense aggregates, and the mast cells show aberrant CD25 expression. Reticulin staining demonstrates marked diffuse fibrosis. In a patient with persistent hypereosinophilia, negative KIT D816V, and an FIP1L1::PDGFRA fusion detected by NGS, findings are consistent with myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and FIP1L1::PDGFRA rearrangement, presenting with CEL-like features.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with associated hematologic neoplasm
ddx.vs: SM shows compact dense mast cell aggregates of 15 or more cells and usually KIT D816V, whereas here mast cells are mostly loose/interstitial with PDGFRA fusion and KIT D816V negative.
CEL is defined only after excluding PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, JAK2 and FLT3 rearrangements; detection of FIP1L1::PDGFRA reclassifies the case.
Reactive eosinophilia lacks atypical CD25+ spindle mast cells, marked fibrosis, and a clonal fusion gene.
PMF shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes with JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations rather than eosinophil-predominant hypercellularity with mast cell proliferation.
